chunks: If you fear a breach between them, appoint one arbiter from the people of the man and one from the people of the woman. If they wish to have a settlement then God will reconcile them, for God is all-knowing and cognisant.

key_terms.حَكَمًا: arbiter or judge appointed to resolve disputes
key_terms.يُوَفِّقِ اللَّهُ: God will reconcile or bring about harmony

ai.seo_question: How does Islam recommend resolving marital disputes and potential divorce?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'arbiter' (hakam) is often interpreted as a wise judge or mediator, emphasizing the communal responsibility to preserve the family unit before divorce. This verse establishes a structured, three-stage process for conflict resolution, highlighting that divine facilitation (tawfiq) is contingent upon the arbiters' sincere intent for reconciliation. It underscores the principle that God’s omniscience extends to the inner states of the couple, guiding the arbiters' efforts with precision.
